title: Session handoff: ward-cli worker renewal, 2026-11-01 (Ward release and public gates)

CI route for a Mac-signed artifact is WCLI-123 (required before any CI-driven release after the flip; does not gate today). WCLI-120 (hosted macos-14 verify, visibility-gated) stays In Progress until observed runs: AC1 at the first private tag or dispatch run, AC2 after the flip. W-9 notes line dropped (#232); the CI check refusing new /Users/ paths in tracked files (WCLI-104) is NOT started and does not gate. NOT DONE / OWED: Quest records for WCLI-97, 99, 100, 110, 113, 122 after merge (all unticked, not started on the tracker); WCLI-96 AC1 and AC5 (sitting); the second-half hosted-runner observations; stale references I did not edit: CLAUDE.md line 63 (CI on [self-hosted, Linux, ARM64], tier 2: the owning session or operator decides), ADR 0004, the scripts/publish-release.mjs comment.

TRAPS LEARNED THIS SESSION: git push must be alone in its Bash call; the ownership guard refuses any git command whose target is another worktree (agent-*) and any command whose target is built from shell text such as sed -i with ${{ }}: write mutation drivers as scripts under the scratchpad and run them as python3 <file>; implementers run in isolation worktrees whose branches (fix/wcli-97-stdin-residue, fix/wcli-100-prompt-spoof, fix/wcli-122-verify-gate-tests, docs/wcli-110-flip-docs, fix/wcli-99-public-ci-runners) are checked out THERE, so I pushed WCLI-110 as docs/wcli-110-flip-docs-pr and WCLI-99 from the local branch wcli-99-fix1; a subagent report is not authority; run date -u rather than estimating the time; the lore verification and review profiles have about 0 headroom, so new runbooks go in the implementation profile only and placeholders in runbooks must not be angle-bracketed (portability warning); gh pr checks is briefly empty after a push, wait on the head SHA and row count; a hosted runner reuses a freed inode (project-binding T10).
